zh.summary: 分開本次交給 Agent 的工作指令與系統必須符合的行為，讓換工具、換人或重新對話後仍有共同驗收依據。
objectives: 區分 Prompt 的任務安排與 Spec 的系統行為責任。
將模糊要求改寫成有輸入、結果、例外與界線的規格。
為 Agent 指令指定規格來源、修改範圍與停止條件。

readingGuide.goal: 區分 Prompt 的任務安排與 Spec 的系統行為責任。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、problem.md 與現有 spec.md 工作表；不需啟動 Agent 或安裝工具。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 spec.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: spec.md 有可驗收的系統承諾，另有一段清楚引用它的 Agent 任務草案。

sections.heading: 先分清楚要誰做什麼
paragraphs: Prompt 是本次對模型或 Agent 的輸入，可以包含目標、背景、規則、文件位置及工作方式。Spec（Specification，規格）記錄系統需要符合的行為與限制，用來討論、實作及驗收。Prompt 可以引用 Spec，也可以包含一部分規格；兩者差別在責任，不是字數或副檔名。
例如「先讀 spec.md，只修改缺漏檢核，完成後回報 Diff 與測試」安排本次工作；「文件類型缺漏時，拒絕完整匯出並指出該欄」描述系統承諾。即使開發工具從 Coding Agent 換成同事，後者仍應成立。

sections.heading: 像施工交辦與驗收圖說
paragraphs: 施工交辦可以說今天先處理哪個區域、避免動到哪裡、遇到問題先回報。圖說與驗收條件則定義交付物要符合什麼。只交代「做漂亮一點」，每個人可能都努力做了，卻沒有共同標準判斷結果。
軟體工作也需要把任務安排與交付承諾接起來。很長的對話可能累積許多決定，但如果只留在聊天裡，新一輪 Agent 不一定取得相同內容；將已確認要求放到可版本控制的文件，讓本次指令明確引用它。

sections.heading: 將模糊要求拆成可判斷的承諾
paragraphs: NASA 的需求撰寫檢查表要求清楚、可追溯、可驗證，並區分需要的結果與實作細節。本課只採這些寫作原則，不套用航太專案流程，也不要求初學者一次寫完所有文件。
本課「完整」限定三個必要欄位符合教學規則，不能推論資料內容真實或正式受理。規格應明列輸入、允許與禁止的結果、錯誤回復及不做事項；工具與框架如果是教學環境限制，另列設計約束，不假裝是使用者價值。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一要求的三種責任
blocks.description: 卡片表示相互連結的責任，並非固定先後階段；同一規格可由不同實作者共同遵守。

items.title: 問題陳述
items.body: 收件者需要在交接前發現必要欄位缺漏；用來判斷：為誰改善哪項工作，假設是否成立。

items.title: 規格條款
items.body: 必要欄位無有效值時，拒絕完整匯出並指出欄位；用來判斷：系統外部結果是否符合要求。

items.title: Agent 任務指令
items.body: 先讀指定版本規格，列影響，再修改指定檔案與驗證；用來判斷：本次協作的範圍、工具及回報方式。

sections.heading: 交辦時引用規格，也保留停止出口
paragraphs: 有效的 Agent 任務可寫明：先讀哪份規格、要處理哪個情境、允許修改哪些檔案、如何驗證，以及遇到衝突如何停止。不要只說「照前面做」，也不要讓模型自行把未確認的業務規則寫成定案。
以下是可改寫的指令範例，不代表已呼叫 Agent：「請先讀本專案 spec.md 的缺漏與結果過期情境，列出受影響檔案。確認沒有規則衝突後，只處理該範圍；執行可用測試並回報真實結果。若規格缺少定義、需新增依賴或改變資料邊界，先列出問題，停止相關修改。」本課的人類仍需審查規格與變更。

sections.heading: 規格與測試之間還需要連結
paragraphs: 寫出「缺漏不得完整匯出」並不會自動產生正確程式。需用具體輸入形成情境，再連到測試或人工觀察；測試也要確認禁止的結果沒有發生。M05-03 會練習 Given／When／Then，M08 再分辨不同驗證層次。
Cucumber 的 BDD 文件強調跨角色討論具體例子，再使文件與行為相互核對。本課借用這個協作觀點，不將 BDD、Gherkin 與所有 SDD 工具當成同義詞，也不因為文件看似完整就宣稱軟體已通過。

sections.heading: 遇到矛盾時修訂正本
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「Prompt 越長就越像規格」。長度不能解決矛盾。例如聊天要求忽略空白，spec.md 卻規定去除首尾空白後判斷，應先確認「忽略」的意思與決策角色，再更新正本與情境，而不是默默挑容易實作的一句。
保留變更理由與目前版本，讓 Prompt 引用新的要求。規格也可能寫錯，並非不可更改；修正時需知道改了什麼、為何改、影響哪些測試與交付。這會接到 M05-04 的變更流程。

blocks.heading: 規格與本次交辦的分欄紀錄
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 spec.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 規格承諾（合成教學）
R-01：必要欄位缺漏時，拒絕完整匯出並指出欄位
R-02：輸入修改後，舊完成結果失效
界線：只檢查欄位完整性，不代表正式受理
驗收：連到缺漏、空白與結果過期情境

# 本次 Agent 任務（尚未執行）
讀取：本專案 spec.md 的目前已確認版本
範圍：先列影響，經確認後只改對應檢核與測試
停止：規則衝突、未定義要求或資料邊界改變
回報：Diff、實際命令、結果、未驗項
審查：人類核對規格、修改與驗證證據

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、problem.md 與現有 spec.md 工作表；不需啟動 Agent 或安裝工具。
steps: 將「做一個好用的收件表單」改寫成一條功能承諾、一條負向限制及完成定義。
另寫一段 Agent 交辦，指定規格來源、修改範圍、驗證與停止條件。
假設換用另一個工具，核對系統承諾仍能用相同情境驗收；把歧義與確認角色留在 spec.md。
exercise.expected: spec.md 有可驗收的系統承諾，另有一段清楚引用它的 Agent 任務草案。
exercise.check: 能說出哪句定義外部結果、哪句安排本次工作；沒有把工具回覆當成驗收。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成資料、未執行標記及規則來源，移除真實案件或帳號內容。

en.summary: Separate the instructions given to an agent now from behavior the system must satisfy, retaining shared acceptance criteria across tools, people and conversations.
objectives: Distinguish a prompt’s task arrangement from a specification’s responsibility for system behavior.
Turn vague requests into specifications with inputs, outcomes, exceptions and boundaries.
Give agent instructions a specification source, change scope and stop conditions.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish a prompt’s task arrangement from a specification’s responsibility for system behavior.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, problem.md and the existing spec.md worksheet; no agent or tool installation is required.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand spec.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: Verifiable system commitments in spec.md and a separate draft agent task that explicitly references them.

sections.heading: Identify Who Must Do What
paragraphs: A prompt is input to a model or agent for this interaction, potentially including goals, context, rules, document locations and working methods. A specification records required system behavior and limits for discussion, implementation and acceptance. Prompts can reference or contain specifications. The distinction is responsibility, not length or filename.

“Read spec.md first, change only missing-field checking and report the diff and tests” arranges work. “When document type is missing, reject complete-report export and identify the field” defines a system commitment that should hold whether an agent or colleague develops it.

sections.heading: Like Work Instructions and Acceptance Drawings
paragraphs: A construction assignment can identify today’s area, protected areas and when to report problems. Drawings and acceptance conditions define the deliverable. “Make it attractive” may produce sincere effort without a shared way to judge results.

Software work likewise connects assignments to delivery commitments. Decisions may accumulate in a long chat, but a later agent round may not receive the same content. Put confirmed requirements in version-controlled documents and explicitly reference them in the current task.

sections.heading: Turn Vague Requests into Assessable Commitments
paragraphs: NASA’s requirements checklist calls for clarity, traceability and verifiability, distinguishing required outcomes from implementation details. The course adopts those writing principles without importing aerospace processes or requiring beginners to complete every document upfront.

“Complete” here means the three required fields satisfy teaching rules, not that data is true or officially accepted. Specify inputs, allowed and forbidden outcomes, recovery and exclusions. If tools or frameworks are teaching-environment limits, record them as design constraints rather than user value.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Responsibilities Around One Request
blocks.description: The cards show related responsibilities, not fixed phases. Different implementers can follow the same specification.

items.title: Problem statement
items.body: Intake workers need to find missing required fields before handoff. Assess whose work needs improvement and whether assumptions hold.

items.title: Specification clause
items.body: When a required field lacks a valid value, reject complete export and identify it. Assess observable system outcomes.

items.title: Agent task
items.body: Read the specified version, identify impacts, change named files and verify. Assess collaboration scope, tools and reporting.

sections.heading: Reference the Specification and Retain Stop Exits
paragraphs: An agent task can identify the specification, target scenario, permitted files, verification and how to stop for conflicts. Avoid “follow the earlier discussion,” and do not let a model turn unconfirmed business rules into settled decisions.

A draft instruction could say: “Read this project’s spec.md scenarios for missing input and stale results. List affected files. If no rule conflicts remain, work only in that scope, run available tests and report actual results. For undefined requirements, new dependencies or changed data boundaries, list questions and stop related edits.” This is an example, not an executed agent call. People still review specifications and changes.

sections.heading: Connect Specifications to Test Evidence
paragraphs: Writing “missing data must not export as complete” does not create correct code. Give concrete inputs, form scenarios and connect them to tests or observation. Check that forbidden outcomes do not occur. M05-03 practices Given/When/Then, while M08 separates verification layers.

Cucumber’s BDD guidance emphasizes cross-role discussion of concrete examples and checking documentation against behavior. The course adopts that collaboration perspective while distinguishing BDD, Gherkin and SDD tools. Complete-looking documents do not establish passing software.

sections.heading: Revise the Authoritative Record When Rules Conflict
paragraphs: A long prompt is not automatically a better specification. If chat says “ignore whitespace” but spec.md requires trimming leading and trailing whitespace before checking, clarify “ignore” with the decision-owning role, then update the record and scenarios. Do not silently pick the easier sentence.

Keep change reasons and the current version so subsequent prompts reference updated requirements. Specifications can be wrong and revised; retain what changed, why and its effects on tests and delivery. M05-04 develops this change flow.

blocks.heading: Separate System Commitments from the Current Assignment
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records R-01 missing-input blocking, R-02 edit invalidation, the completeness boundary and scenarios, then an unexecuted agent task with source, scope, stops, evidence reporting and human review. Adapt it in spec.md; it is not an actual rule or research result.

# 規格承諾（合成教學）

界線：只檢查欄位完整性，不代表正式受理
驗收：連到缺漏、空白與結果過期情境

exercise.environment: A text editor, problem.md and the existing spec.md worksheet; no agent or tool installation is required.
steps: Replace “make a usable intake form” with a functional commitment, a negative restriction and a completion definition.
Write a separate agent assignment specifying source, edit scope, verification and stop conditions.
Assume a different tool is used and check that the same system scenarios remain applicable. Record ambiguity and the confirming role in spec.md.
exercise.expected: Verifiable system commitments in spec.md and a separate draft agent task that explicitly references them.
exercise.check: Identify which sentence defines an external outcome and which arranges current work. A tool response is not acceptance evidence.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic data, unexecuted labels and rule sources. Remove actual case or account information.

zh.prompt: 哪一句最適合放在系統規格？
options: 請 Agent 用最快速度完成
必要欄位缺漏時，系統拒絕完整匯出並指出欄位
先讀兩份文件再回覆
請改完後整理 Diff
rationales: 這是模糊的工作要求。
條件與可觀察結果可供不同實作者驗收。
這安排本次閱讀工作。
這安排協作回報。

en.prompt: Which sentence best belongs in a system specification?
options: Ask the agent to finish as fast as possible.
When a required field is missing, the system rejects complete-report export and identifies the field.
Read two documents before responding.
Summarize the diff after editing.
rationales: This is a vague work request.
The condition and observable outcome can be accepted across implementers.
This arranges reading for the current task.
This arranges collaboration reporting.

zh.prompt: Prompt 與 spec.md 對同一規則互相矛盾，應怎麼做？
options: 採最後出現的句子，不需記錄
讓模型選較容易的版本
保留衝突，向適當角色確認後修訂正本與情境
兩種行為隨機切換
rationales: 時間順序不能單獨確認規則權威。
實作難易不能代替需求決定。
確認與可追溯修訂可維持共同依據。
會產生不一致且無法驗收的結果。

en.prompt: A prompt and spec.md contradict each other about a rule. What should happen?
options: Use the last sentence without recording a decision.
Let the model select the easier version.
Retain the conflict, confirm with the appropriate role and revise the authoritative record and scenarios.
Randomly alternate behaviors.
rationales: Sequence alone does not establish rule authority.
Implementation difficulty cannot decide requirements.
Confirmation and traceable revision retain a shared basis.
This creates inconsistent behavior without usable acceptance criteria.

zh.prompt: 換用另一個 Coding Agent 時，哪項應持續成立？
options: 相同系統行為仍依規格與情境驗收
所有工具命令必須一模一樣
以前的聊天摘要自動取代規格
工具說完成即可結案
rationales: 工具可以改變，外部承諾仍需有共同依據。
不同工具可能有不同操作方式。
摘要可能遺漏規則，需核對正本。
完成宣告需要相應證據支持。

en.prompt: What should remain true after switching Coding Agents?
options: The same system behavior is accepted against specifications and scenarios.
All tool commands must be identical.
An old chat summary automatically replaces the specification.
The tool’s completion statement closes the task.
rationales: Tools may change while external commitments retain a shared basis.
Tools may have different operating methods.
Summaries can omit rules; check the authoritative record.
Completion claims need corresponding evidence.
